title: Export holds every part the search matches, including rows not yet loaded
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Exactly 35 inventory parts whose numbers start with {Prefix-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-EXPALL, numbered -01 to -35) are active at {Location-A}.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-EXPOTHER-01) is active at {Location-A}, and its number does not start with {Prefix-A}.
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  2. Type {Prefix-A} in the Search box.
  3. Do not scroll the list.
  4. Click the ⋮ actions menu button in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  5. Click Export.
  6. Open the downloaded file and count its part rows.
  7. Look in the file for {Part-A}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: A file downloads.
  • Step 6: The file holds 35 part rows, one for each part whose number starts with {Prefix-A}. The list loads only 30 rows until you scroll, so the file also holds the 5 rows that were not yet loaded (35 − 30 = 5).
  • Step 7: {Part-A} is not in the file, because the search does not match it.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10814 (Story 1, Active and Inactive Tabs on the Inventory List); story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S1-R9b, S1-R9, S2-R6, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 4.1 (The actions menu), 13 Oct copy. Product's answer of 13 Oct (Chris Ward, question 4). Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R9b: “The export includes every part on that tab that matches the current search, filters and Supply filter, including parts not yet scrolled into view. With nothing matching, the message "Empty export" shows and no file is made.”
  • S1-R9: “Export in the actions menu exports the parts on the tab that shows: active parts from the Active tab, inactive parts from the Inactive tab.”
  • S2-R6: “The checkbox in the header ticks or clears every row loaded in the list. The list loads 30 parts at a time as the user scrolls, so it ticks only the rows loaded so far. The count in the bar shows exactly how many parts will change.”
